m: निर्-˚दाह mfn. burning, AV.
निर्-˚दाह m. N. of a partic. Agni, ib.
the act of burning up (see अ-निर्दाह).
निर्-˚दाहुक mfn. burning (see अ-निर्दाहुक).
निर्—दाक्षिण्य mfn. uncourteous, Kād.
निर्—दारिद्र्य mfn. free from poverty, wealthy, Kathās.
निर्-दारित See निर्-√ दॄ.
निर्-˚दारित mfn. torn asunder, split open, Hariv.
a: निर्दारित — a. 1 Torn, rent. --2 Opened, split open; Śi. 18. 28.

a: निर्दातृ — m. 1 A digger up of weeds, weeder. --2 A donor. --3 A husbandman, reaper.

nirdDArita
tri॰ nira + DAri--kta । 1 nirdDAraRavizaye 2 niScite ca “nirdDArite'rTe leKena KalUktvA Kalu nAcikam” mAGaH ।
nirdDAryya

nirdDUta
tri॰ nir + DU--karmaRi kta । niraste “nirDUtavItamapi bAlakamullalantam” mAGaH ।
nirdDana
tri॰ nirgataM Danamasya । 1 DanaSUnya daridre “SaSinastulyavaMSo'pi nirdDanaH pariBUyate” cARakyaH । 2 jaradgave pu॰ Sabdaca॰ ।
nirdDarma
tri॰ nirgato DarmAt nirA॰ ta॰ । DarmabahirBUte “nirdDarmmArTa karma kuryyuSca pArTAH” BA॰ u॰ 24 a॰ ।

m: निर्—दैन्य mfn. free from misery, comfortable, at ease, Kathās.; Rājat.
निर्-√ दॄ (only pf. -ददार), to tear or rend asunder, BhP. : Caus. -दारयति id., Hariv.; to cause to be dug up, Rājat.
निर्-√ दी (only impf. -अदीयम्), to fly away, RV. iv, 27, 1 (cf. निर्-डीन).
निर्-√ दंश् P. -दशति (pres. p. -दशत् and ˚शमान ind.p. -दश्य), to bite through, bite, gnash or grind the teeth, MBh.; Hariv.
निर्—दंशिन् mfn. (snake) not biting or stinging, AitBr.

v: nirdaRqa
tri॰ niHSezeRa daRqo yasya prA॰ ba॰ । sarvaprakArada RqArhe 1 SUdre “vAcA daRqo brAhmaRAnAM kzatriyARA BujArpaRam । dAnadaRqAH smftA vESyA nirdaRqaH SUdra ucyate” BA॰ SA॰ 15 a॰ । 2 daRqanArhe ca
m: निर्—दण्ड mfn. not punishing, MBh.
a Śūdra, L. (as the staffless?).

v: nirdaSa
tri॰ nirgatAni daSa dinAni yasya qasamA॰ । atikrAntadaSAhe “nirdaSaM jYAtimaraRaM SrutvA putrasya janma ca” manuH “yaTA vE paSurnirdaSo BavatyaTa sa meDyo Bavati” Eta॰ brA॰ 714
m: निर्—दश mfn. more than ten days old, happened more than ten days ago (-ता f., ĀpGṛ.), AitBr.; Mn. &c. (cf. a -निर्-द्˚).
निर्—दश˚नाक्षि-जिह्व mfn. deprived of teeth and eyes and tongue, MBh.
निर्—दशन mfn. toothless, Hit.
निर्—दश—ता f., ĀpGṛ.
2. निर्-˚दग्ध mfn. burnt, burnt up, MBh.; Hariv. &c.

v: nirda(rdi)gDikA
strI nir + daha--diha--vA ktasaMjYAyAM kan kApi ata ittvam । nidigDikAyAm hemaca॰ ।
m: निर्-˚दग्धिका f. = नि-दिग्धिका, or निर्-दिग्धिका.
निर्-√ दह् P. Ā. -दहति, ˚ते (inf. -दहस्, Br.), to burn out, burn up, consume by fire, destroy completely, RV. &c. &c.: Caus. -दाहयति, to cause to burn up or set on fire, Rājat.
a: निर्दह् — {c1c} P. 1 To burn, consume. --2 To torment, distress, pain.

m: निर्-˚दहना f. Sanseviera Roxburghiana, Suśr.

v: nirdahana
pu॰ nitarAM dahati nir + daha--lyu । 1 BallAtake Sabdara॰ । 2 mUrvAlatAyAM strI rAjani॰ । nirgatodahano vahniH dahanaM vA yasmAt prA॰ ba॰ । 3 vahniSUnye 4 dAhaSUnye ca tri॰ ।
m: 1. निर्—दहन mfn. (for 2. See निर्-दह्) not burning, W.
2. निर्-˚दहन mf(ई)n. burning up, consuming, AV.
निर्-˚दहन m. Semecarpus Anacardium, L.
निर्-˚दहन n. burning, ib.
a: निर्दहन — a. 1 Burning, consuming. --2 Without fire or heat. --नं Burning, consuming.

v: nirdahas
avya॰ nir + daha--tumarTe “ISvare tosunkasunO” pA॰ kasun । nirdagDumityarTe “apaSavyeva tu vA ISvarA paSUnnirdahaH” tA॰ brA॰ 273

m: निर्-दलन n. (√ दल्) splitting, cleaving asunder, breaking, Vcar.; Rājat.
निर्—दन्त mfn. (elephant) having no teeth or tusks, Subh.

v: nirdara
pu॰ nir + dF--karmaRi ap । 1 nirJare 2 nirBare ca “girinirdaravAsinAm” rAmA॰ ayo॰ 28 sa॰ । nirgatodaro yasmAt prA॰ va॰ 3 nirBaye tri॰ 4 sAre na॰ 5 kaWine 6 apatrape ca tri॰ medi॰ ।
m: 1. निर्—दर mfn. (fr. √ दृ [?]; cf. -दट) pitiless, hard, shameless
2. निर्-दर m. (√ दॄ) a cave, cavern, R. (v.l. ˚रि)
a: निर्दर — a. 1 Hard. --2 Pitiless. --3 Shameless. --रः, --निर्दरिः 1 A cave, cavern. --2 A waterfall, spring. --रं Essence (सार).

m: निर्—दरण mf(आ)n. free from clefts or holes, Kam.
निर्—दरम् ind. excessively, strongly, L.
2. निर्-दर—वासिन् mfn. inhabiting a cave, ib.
निर्—दस्यु mfn. (a place) free from robbers, MBh.; Hariv.

v: nirdawa
tri॰ nirdaya(ra) + pfzo॰ । 1 dayAhIne 2 parApavAdake 3 nizprayojane ca medi॰ । 4 mantre 5 tIvre ca SabdaratrA॰ ।
m: निर्—दट or निर्—दड, mfn. (Prākṛ. for दृत fr. √ दृ cf. आ-दृ?) unkind, malicious, censorious, slanderous; useless, unnecessary; mad, intoxicated, L.
a: निर्दट --ड — a. 1 Unkind, unfeeling, unmerciful. --2 Rejoicing over the faults of others. --3 Envious. --4 Abusive, slanderous. --5 Useless, unnecessary. --6 Violent. --7 Mad, intoxicated.

m: निर्—द˚यास्लेष m. a p˚ embrace, Megh. 105.
निर्—दय mf(आ)n. pitiless, unkind, cruel, hard, violent, excessive, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
unpitied by any, Mn. ix, 239
निर्—द˚य-दन्त-दंश m. unmerciful or passionate biting (with the teeth), Gīt.
निर्—दयम् ind. unmercifully, passionately, violently, greatly, Kāv. (˚य-तरम्, Bhartṛ. i, 64)
निर्—द˚य-रति-श्रमालस mf(आ)n. tired by p˚ amorous sports, Ragh. xix, 32
निर्—दय—त्व n. unmercifulness, cruelty, Kāv.

v: nirdeSa

pu॰ nir + diSa--BAve GaY । 1 SAsane AjYAyAM 2 kaTane 3 upadeSe ca । nirdiSyate'BiDIyate'nena karaRe GaY । 4 pratipAdakaSabdaBede nAmni “o~ tatsaditi nirdeSo brahmaRastriviDaH smftaH” gItA । 5 vetane ca “kAlameva pratIkzeta nirddeSaM Bftako yaTA” iti purARam । nirgatro deSAt nirA॰ ta॰ । 2 deSAnnirgate tri॰ 6 upAnte ca medi॰ ।
m: निर्-˚देश m. pointing out, indicating, directing, order, command, instruction (often ifc.), Mn.; Kāv.; Pur.
description, specification, special mention, details or particulars, GṛŚrS.; R.; Suśr. &c.
vicinity, proximity, L.
certainty, ascertainment, W.
a partic. number, Buddh.
a: निर्देशः — 1 Pointing out, showing, indicating. --2 Order, command, direction; R. 12. 17. --3 Advice, instruction. --4 Telling, saying, declaring. --5 Specifying, particularization, specification, specific mention; अयूक्तोयं निर्देशः Mbh.; Bg. 17. 23. --6 Ascertainment. --7 Vicinity, proximity. --8 Description, designation.

k.v: न्याय्यं च त्रिषु षट्संप्रधारणा तु समर्थनम्. अववादस्तु निर्देशो निदेशः शासनं च सः॥

m: निर्-˚देश—कारिन् mfn. executing orders, obedient, BhP.
निर्-˚देशक mfn. pointing out, showing, indicating
describing, defining, TPrāt.
ordering, MW.
निर्-˚देशनीय (MW.) mfn. to be pointed out or determined or described or proclaimed or foretold.
निर्-˚देश—पालन n. obeying a command, R.
निर्-˚देश्य (Mn.; MBh. &c.) mfn. to be pointed out or determined or described or proclaimed or foretold.

निर्-√ दिश् P. -दिशति (aor. -अदिक्षत्, Daś.; Bhaṭṭ. ind.p. -दिश्य, Śak.; Mālav.; inf. -देष्टुम्, MBh.), to point to (acc.), show, Mṛcch.; Śak. &c.; to assign anything to, destine for (dat. or gen.), Hariv.; R. &c.; to indicate, state, name, define, specify, Br.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; to take for, regard as (with double acc.), Mn.; Vet.; to announce, proclaim, foretell, prophesy, MBh.; Var.; to recommend, advise, suggest (with double acc.), Hit. : Desid. -दिदिक्षति, to wish to point out or define more closely, Śaṃk.
a: निर्दिश् — {c6c} P. 1 To point out, indicate, show; एकैकं निर्दिशन् Ś. 7; अंगुल्या निर्दिशति &c. --2 To assign, give; निर्दिष्टां कुलपतिना स पर्णशालामध्यास्य R. 1. 95. --3 To allude to, mention, make a reference to. --4 To foretell, predict. --5 To advise, recommend. --6 To tell, communicate. --7 To enjoin, direct. --8 To enumerate, specify, name. --9 To define, determine. --10 To describe. --11 To denounce, accuse.
